figures.heading: New Customer today
captions: Production, captured for Splitting Sales Representatives (its canvas board 2.2). No Credit Terms field on New Customer: every new customer starts on COD.

texts.text: Production, captured for Splitting Sales Representatives (its canvas board 2.2). No Credit Terms field on New Customer: every new customer starts on COD.

figures.heading: New Customer: Credit Terms prefilled with the default
captions: For a user with View and Manage AP/AR Data. Credit Terms is filled in with the shop default (here Due on Receipt) and can be changed before saving.
Credit Limit now sits beside it, as on Edit Customer, and starts blank (blank means no limit). Same gate as Credit Terms: View and Manage AP/AR Data.
Field order from CustomerDialog.vue on both branches: State/Province and Country, then Credit Terms (with Credit Limit beside it on Edit), then the Sales Representative field(s).

The Sales Representative field(s) come from Splitting Sales Representatives (SV-10890): labels, + and x buttons and spacing from its design canvas (page 2, boards 2.12 and 2.16) and its build (SalesRepAssignment.vue).
Source: CustomerDialog.vue field layout, drawn with DS Text field and Select.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).

figures.heading: New Customer: the Credit Terms picker
captions: The picker lists the active terms in the S1-R5 order: COD, Due on Receipt, Net terms by days (the shop's own Net 10 between Net 7 and Net 15), day-of-month terms by day, any other term A to Z, Credit Hold last. Deactivated terms are not offered.
No hover hints on the options, as in the build (r11-01).
The shop default (Due on Receipt) carries the same "Default" tag as the Credit Terms table. Vendor pickers show no tag: the default applies to new customers only.
Source: DS Menus, text-only rows, selected row tinted; DS Badge for the tag.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).

figures.heading: New Customer: COD picked, limit locked at $0
captions: Picking COD or Credit Hold sets Credit Limit to $0 and disables it (DS disabled input). Hover: "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit."
Picking any other term makes the field editable again; blank means no limit.
On touch screens a tap on the locked Credit Limit shows the same explanation as text under the field (r14-03).
The same rule applies on Edit Customer (page 6).
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).
